scope: Bundled browser client slice, not whole-package compatibility

plugins.source: Original client source bytes retained and digest checked before build

providers.adapted: EAP injects active zh/en locale. Original configForms settings provider and LanguageRow are not activated. No remote persistence or DSH settings UI.

providers.retained: Original browser ShortcutsService, registry, keyboard adapter and web storage
providers.adapted: Browser web branch only; desktop bridge and closeWindow unavailable. No command for EAP copy is advertised.

providers.retained: Original MenuOverlay, ContextMenuButton and browser primitives
providers.adapted: Narrow EAP shell.overlay provider, snapshot hook injection, root props and factory ownership. No DSH layout/store/workspace, keyed icon/content contributions, or full renderer registry. Empty keyed outlets have no contributions in this roster.

providers.retained: Original createClientModuleSystem, manifest parser, queue/live registration and static module identity cache
providers.adapted: Reviewed statically bundled factories only. No network scripts, URLs, Node host or hot release transport. Original ES module namespace evaluation occurs at bundle import; registration/materialization and Cordis activation remain separate.

limits: Same-page trusted JavaScript is not sandboxed
No DSH Host APIs, Agent, RPC or execution authority
Message IDs are captured EAP UI scope keys, not new persisted authority
Original View.tsx gives duplicate sibling React key warning when notice id equals menu occurrence; copy/failure behavior tested
Browser visual acceptance remains a host-level check
